nodes.description: Ownable._owner: privileged owner address used by onlyOwner and fee-exclusion logic.
Mapping of reflection balances (_rOwned) mutated during transfers.
Mapping of token balances (_tOwned), declared but unused.
ERC20 allowance mapping read/written by approve and transferFrom.
Mapping flagging accounts exempt from tax/team fees.
Constant total token supply used in rate and maxTx calculations.
Total reflections supply, reduced by _reflectFee.
Accumulated token fees, increased by _reflectFee.
Reflection tax fee percentage (default 5).
Team fee percentage (default 10) used for team allocation.
Blacklist mapping controlled by setBots/delBot and checked in _transfer.
Per-address cooldown timestamp mapping set from block.timestamp.
Payable team wallet receiving ETH via sendETHToFee.
Uniswap V2 router used for swaps and liquidity.
Created Uniswap pair address used for swap-trigger checks.
Enables the anti-bot cooldown logic inside _transfer.
Global switch enabling automatic contract-token swaps.
Reentrancy lock flag set by lockTheSwap around swaps.
Flag guarding openTrading so liquidity is added only once.
Maximum transfer amount enforced in _transfer.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for auth and transfer origin.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time used for cooldowns and deadlines.
owner(): returns the stored _owner address.
renounceOwnership(): owner-only function that zeroes the owner.
modifier onlyOwner: requires _owner == _msgSender().
transfer(address,uint256): public entry point routing to _transfer.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): moves tokens via _transfer and updates allowance.
approve(address,uint256): sets allowance via _approve.
setCooldownEnabled(bool): owner-only toggle of cooldownEnabled.
_transfer(address,address,uint256): core logic enforcing bot/cooldown/maxTx checks and triggering swap+ETH send.
_tokenTransfer: applies/removes fees around the standard transfer.
_transferStandard: updates rOwned balances, takes team fee and reflects fee.
swapTokensForEth(uint256): swaps contract tokens for ETH through the router under lockTheSwap.
sendETHToFee(uint256): transfers ETH balance to _teamAddress.
openTrading(): owner-only setup of router, pair and initial liquidity.
manualswap(): team-only manual swap of the contract token balance.
manualsend(): team-only manual ETH send to the team address.
setBots(address[]): owner-only batch blacklisting.
delBot(address): owner-only removal from blacklist.
_takeTeam(uint256): mints reflection share to the contract for team fees.
_reflectFee(uint256,uint256): reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
_getValues(uint256): computes t/r amounts, fees and team shares.
_getTValues: pure token-side fee math (mul/div/sub).
_getRValues: pure reflection-side amount math.
_getRate(): rSupply/tSupply division used as conversion rate.
_getCurrentSupply(): returns current reflection and token supply.
setMaxTxPercent(uint256): owner-only recomputation of _maxTxAmount.
receive(): accepts ETH from router swaps.
External call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with user-supplied deadline.
External call uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH forwarding contract ETH balance.
External ETH transfer to _teamAddress via .transfer(amount).
External call to IUniswapV2Factory.createPair returning an arbitrary pair address.
External call IERC20(uniswapV2Pair).approve with max uint allowance.
Reflection/fee arithmetic (mul/div/sub) on tAmount, tTeam and rate values.
Parameter 'from' (sender) of _transfer.
Parameter 'to' (recipient) of _transfer.
Parameter 'amount' of _transfer.
Local bool takeFee computed from _isExcludedFromFee in _transfer.
Local contractTokenBalance read from balanceOf(address(this)) in _transfer.
Parameter 'tokenAmount' of swapTokensForEth.
Local address[] path [token, WETH] built in swapTokensForEth.
Parameter 'amount' of sendETHToFee.
Parameter 'tAmount' of _transferStandard.
Parameter 'tTeam' of _takeTeam.
Parameter 'maxTxPercent' of setMaxTxPercent.

edges.reason: onlyOwner compares _owner to _msgSender(), so the caller controls access decisions.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of funds.
transferFrom debits allowances from _msgSender().
approve sets allowance for _msgSender().
_transfer requires _msgSender() to be the router or pair when cooldown is enabled.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
openTrading is guarded by onlyOwner on the caller address.
cooldown[to] is compared with and set from block.timestamp (timestamp dependency).
swap deadline is block.timestamp, making execution time miner-influenced.
addLiquidityETH deadline is block.timestamp.
onlyOwner reads the stored _owner for authorization.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership writes _owner to address(0), changing the privilege state.
_transferStandard reads and writes _rOwned balances.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee adds tFee to _tFeeTotal.
_getValues feeds _taxFee into the fee computation.
_tokenTransfer toggles _teamFee via removeAllFee/restoreAllFee.
_isExcludedFromFee decides whether fees are taken in _transfer.
_transfer checks bots[from] and bots[to] to block blacklisted accounts.
cooldown mapping stores block.timestamp based limits that gate transfers.
sendETHToFee sends the ETH amount to _teamAddress.
swapTokensForEth calls WETH() and the swap on uniswapV2Router.
openTrading uses uniswapV2Router for factory, liquidity and approvals.
openTrading stores the newly created pair into uniswapV2Pair.
_transfer branches on from == uniswapV2Pair to detect buys.
cooldownEnabled gates the anti-bot restriction block in _transfer.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap-and-send block in _transfer.
inSwap lock flag is set/checked around swapTokensForEth.
tradingOpen guards openTrading from repeated invocation.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount.
setMaxTxPercent recomputes _maxTxAmount with mul/div.
_tTotal is multiplied by maxTxPercent in setMaxTxPercent.
_getCurrentSupply initializes tSupply from _tTotal.
setCooldownEnabled writes cooldownEnabled.
openTrading sets tradingOpen = true.
openTrading sets swapEnabled = true.
openTrading overwrites _maxTxAmount with a new literal value.
setBots writes true into the bots mapping.
delBot writes false into the bots mapping.
_getTValues performs mul/div/sub fee arithmetic.
_getRValues performs mul/sub reflection arithmetic.
_takeTeam multiplies tTeam by the current rate.
swapTokensForEth approves the router as spender before swapping.
sender parameter flows into the balance updates of _transfer.
recipient parameter flows into the balance updates of _transfer.
amount parameter is checked and forwarded in _transfer.
takeFee local derives from fee-exclusion state inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance local is computed from balanceOf and passed to the swap.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
path local array is passed to the router swap call.
amount parameter is transferred to the team address.
tAmount parameter is converted via _getValues in _transferStandard.
tTeam parameter is scaled by currentRate in _takeTeam.
maxTxPercent parameter drives the _maxTxAmount computation.
transfer invokes _transfer internally.
transferFrom invokes _transfer internally.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of privileged setters.
_transfer delegates the actual balance movement to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not inSwap.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when a contract ETH balance exists.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard after fee toggling.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute amounts.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the team token share.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the fee values.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues calls _getRate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
swapTokensForEth makes an external router call whose execution happens under the lockTheSwap guard, the critical state-changing exit point.
openTrading performs an external addLiquidityETH call that can re-enter before flags settle.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to _teamAddress.
openTrading calls createPair on an externally supplied factory, an external callback entry point.
openTrading calls approve on the pair address, an arbitrary external contract.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter 'from' is only meaningful inside _transfer and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter 'to' is only meaningful inside _transfer and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter 'amount' of _transfer is an internal argument with no standalone identity.
Local takeFee exists only to drive the _tokenTransfer call inside _transfer.
Local contractTokenBalance is derived and consumed by the swap trigger in _transfer.
Parameter tokenAmount is entirely internal to swapTokensForEth.
Local path array is constructed and consumed solely within swapTokensForEth.
Parameter amount of sendETHToFee is internal to that fee payout function.
Parameter tAmount is internal to _transferStandard and its _getValues call.
Parameter tTeam is internal to _takeTeam and its rate multiplication.
Parameter maxTxPercent is internal to setMaxTxPercent and its arithmetic on _maxTxAmount.
